newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell off Thomson in two parts.
newsitem.headline: France to sell off Thomson in two parts.

text.p: The French government said Wednesday it planned to privatise state-owned defence and consumer electronics group Thomson SAin two separate parts, starting with defence arm Thomson-CSF in early 1997.
A Finance Ministry communique said Thomson Multimedia, the consumer electronics arm, would have to be recapitalized before it could be sold off.
The ministry said the govermnment will keep a so-called "golden share" in Thomson CSF to protect France's defence interests.
It added that Thomson Multimedia would have to implement a recovery plan.

The government announced last week it had abandoned a plan to sell off Thomson SA in one go, after France's Privatisation Commission objected to an offer from Lagardere group, challenging the conditions under which Lagardere planned to spin off Thomson Multimedia to South Korea's Daewoo Electronics.
The suspension of the privatisation was a major embarrassment for Prime Minister Alain Juppe's government and sparked demands from the South Korean government for an explanation from Paris.
